{{Nickname}}
{{Quote|Here's the kicker&mdash;87% match with the written documents I could get my hands on from the cartel.|puesso, on the results of analysis of the report shared by mstrslcr on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
The handle '''puesso''' was the user ID of an individual who was active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[mstrslcr]] shared on a Cularin holonet node forum an incepted report from an unknown party advocating intervention in the running of the<ref name="academic review" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Almas]]' [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]], users on the thread discussed the significance and origins of the message. To evaluate the communique, puesso compared the syntax of the report to the [[Writing/Legends|writing]] in other bodies of work via a [[custom analyzer]]. The [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] node user noted no similarities to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] texts but observed a 50% syntax match with [[Army/Legends|military]] documents, a 63% match with writings by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and an 87% match with texts by the [[Metatheran Cartel]]<ref name="academic review" /> trade organization.<ref name="LFCG" />
